rows.grounds: negative prefix a- joined to mānasā; describes the womb-born ones
yonija plus ablative plural ending; those born from the womb
past participle of root vṛ, selected or granted

items.question: Why does the non-mental one not choose immortality for those born from the womb?
premises: immortality is not chosen for womb-born beings
the non-mental ones are addressed as womb-born
the choice of immortality is withheld by you
items.inference: womb-born beings are denied immortality because it is not chosen for them
uncertainties: referent of amānasā is not fully fixed
agency and voice of vṛtam remain ambiguous
items.plain_english: For the non-mental, womb-born ones, immortality is not chosen by you.
